items.headline: Temporary wall sign permitted at 353 University Ave
items.summary: A temporary exterior sign—a 4-foot by 8-foot aluminum panel wrapped around the building corner—is permitted for installation from August 4 through September 1 at the downtown University Avenue address, with removal required by September 4.

items.headline: New commercial building permitted on Blossom Hill Road
items.summary: A $3.33 million permit was issued for a new commercial building at 696 Blossom Hill Rd. No tenant is listed in the permit.

items.headline: Solar and battery system permitted at Oakland Road site
items.summary: A $2.5 million permit was issued for a solar and battery installation at 1333 Oakland Rd, one of the larger commercial permits in this batch.
